description: Check whether SODAX supports a specific blockchain, given its name, ticker, chain key or EVM chain id (e.g. 'Hedera', 'HBAR', 'hedera', 'Base', 'Arbitrum', '8453'). Use this to answer 'does SODAX support X?' questions authoritatively instead of guessing — it resolves the name to a chain key and confirms against the live network registry.
